text: Photography captures moments through aperture and shutter control, which significantly influence light, depth, and motion. Aperture refers to the size of the lens opening that controls the amount of light entering the camera. By adjusting the aperture, photographers can control the depth of field, which is the range of distance within the scene that appears sharp. Aperture also affects the amount of light reaching the camera, with lower f-stops resulting in a wider opening and more light.
summary: Photography captures moments through aperture and shutter control, influencing light, depth, and motion.
